# firezone_resource (Resource)

Firezone Resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Resource address (IP, CIDR, or DNS)
- `name` (String) Resource name
- `type` (String) Resource type (ip, cidr, dns)

### Optional

- `address_description` (String) Resource address description
- `ip_stack` (String) IP stack type (ipv4_only, ipv6_only, dual). Only supported for DNS resources.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID to connect the resource to. Required for new resources, but not returned by API for existing resources.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID
